  url "ecmascript:
    var CASES = [[[\"/h/html\"], []], [[\"/h/html-xhtml\"], []], [[\"/h/html-charset\"], []], [[\"/h/html-upper\"], []], [[\"/h/html-space\"], []], [[\"/h/html-plain\"], []], [[\"/h/html-none\"], []], [[\"/h/html-gzip\"], []], [[\"/h/s-html-404\"], []], [[\"/h/page.html\"], []], [[\"/h/vrml-named.html\"], []], [[\"/h/r-html\"], []], [[\"/h/r-html-chain\"], []], [[\"/h/r-page-html\"], []], [[\"/h/r-html-cross\"], []], [[\"/h/r-to-404\"], []], [[\"/h/html\"], [\"target=_blank\"]], [[\"/h/html\"], [\"target=_self\"]], [[\"/h/html\"], [\"target=\"]], [[\"/h/html\"], [\"a=b\", \"target=_top\"]], [[\"/h/html-plain\"], [\"target=_blank\"]], [[\"/h/missing\"], [\"target=_blank\"]], [[\"/h/r-html\"], [\"target=_parent\"]], [[\"/h/missing\", \"/h/html\"], []], [[\"/h/html\", \"/h/ok\"], []], [[\"/h/html-plain\", \"/h/html\"], []], [[\"/h/s404\", \"/h/html-xhtml\"], []], [[\"/h/html#Frag\"], []], [[\"/h/html?q=1\"], []], [[\"/h/r-html?q=1#Frag\"], []]];
    var res = [];
    function strip (s) { s = String (s); var o = '', k, e; while ((k = s .indexOf ('http://')) >= 0 && (e = s .indexOf ('/', k + 7)) >= 0) { o += s .substring (0, k); s = s .substring (e + 1); } return o + s; }
    function put (i, v) { res [i] = i + ': ' + v; var o = []; for (var k = 0; k < CASES .length; ++ k) o .push (k in res ? res [k] : k + ': ...'); out = new MFString (... o); }
    function title (t) { var q = String .fromCharCode (34), m = t .indexOf ('title ' + q); return m < 0 ? 'no title' : t .substring (m + 7, t .indexOf (q, m + 7)); }
    function run (i) {
      if (i >= CASES .length) return;
      var p;
      try { p = Browser .loadURL (new MFString (... CASES [i] [0]), new MFString (... CASES [i] [1])); } catch (e) { put (i, 'THROW ' + strip (e .message)); idle = true; return; }
      p .then (function () { put (i, 'RES'); idle = true; }, function (e) { put (i, 'REJ ' + strip (e && e .message)); idle = true; });
    }
    var cycles = 0, next = 0, idle = true; function cycle (t) { if (++ cycles > 3 && idle && next < CASES .length) { idle = false; run (next ++); } }
  "
}

ROUTE CLOCK.cycleTime TO OUT.cycle
